title: Siem Reap: Temples, Trails & Timeless Culture
description: A 5-day adventure through Cambodia's ancient heart — from sunrise at Angkor Wat to floating villages on Tonlé Sap, jungle-wrapped temples, and vibrant night markets.

days.title: The Grand Circuit Begins
days.description: Wake before dawn for the iconic Angkor Wat sunrise, then explore the ancient capital of Angkor Thom and the enigmatic faces of Bayon temple.

activities.name: 🌅 Sunrise at Angkor Wat
activities.description: Arrive by 5 AM to secure a spot by the northern reflecting pool. Watch the sun rise behind the five towers — one of the most photographed moments in Southeast Asia.
details: 📍 Angkor Wat, Angkor Archaeological Park
⏱️ Allow 2–3 hours to explore the temple after sunrise
💡 Head to the less-visited upper galleries while crowds linger at the pools
tips: Your tuk-tuk driver will know the best approach. Agree on pickup time the night before.

activities.name: 🏛️ Angkor Thom & Bayon Temple
activities.description: Enter through the dramatic South Gate lined with 54 stone figures. Bayon's 216 serene stone faces are mesmerizing — explore the bas-reliefs depicting daily Khmer life.
details: 📍 Angkor Thom, 1.5 km north of Angkor Wat
🔍 Don't miss the Terrace of the Elephants and Terrace of the Leper King
⏱️ Allow 2 hours for Bayon alone

activities.name: 🌿 Ta Prohm — The Jungle Temple
activities.description: The "Tomb Raider temple" where massive strangler fig trees engulf ancient stone walls. Wander through atmospheric corridors reclaimed by nature.
details: 📍 Ta Prohm, east of Angkor Thom
📸 The most photogenic tree-root doorway is in the central courtyard
💡 Visit after lunch when morning tour groups have left

activities.name: 🎪 Phare, The Cambodian Circus
activities.description: A jaw-dropping blend of acrobatics, theater, music, and Cambodian storytelling. Proceeds support at-risk youth through arts education.
details: 📍 Phare Circus, Ring Road, Siem Reap
🎟️ Book in advance ($18–38/person) — shows sell out
⏱️ Shows at 8 PM, arrive by 7:30 PM

days.title: Beyond the Main Temples
days.description: Venture deeper into the Cambodian countryside to discover the exquisite pink sandstone carvings of Banteay Srei and the river carvings of Kbal Spean.

activities.name: 🏔️ Kbal Spean — River of a Thousand Lingas
activities.description: A jungle trek (1.5 km uphill) leads to an ancient riverbed carved with Hindu symbols. The trail rewards with a small waterfall — especially beautiful in July's rainy season.
details: 📍 50 km northeast of Siem Reap (1-hour drive)
🥾 Moderate hike — wear sturdy shoes, trail can be slippery
⏱️ 2–3 hours round trip including exploration
tips: Start early to beat the heat. The carvings are underwater during heavy rains — check conditions with your driver.

activities.name: 💎 Banteay Srei — Citadel of Women
activities.description: The most intricately carved temple in Angkor. Pink sandstone reliefs depict scenes from Hindu mythology with extraordinary detail — often called the "jewel of Khmer art."
details: 📍 25 km northeast of main Angkor complex
📸 Best light for photography in the morning
💡 Small but incredibly detailed — allow 45–60 minutes

activities.name: 🍳 Khmer Cooking Class
activities.description: Learn to make amok, green mango salad, and nom krok (coconut pancakes) at a countryside cooking school. Includes a market tour to source fresh ingredients.
details: 📍 Various operators — Le Tigre de Papier or Lily's Secret Garden recommended
🎟️ $15–25 per person including all ingredients and recipes
⏱️ 3-hour class with market visit

activities.name: 🌙 Pub Street & Night Market
activities.description: Siem Reap's buzzing nightlife strip. Browse handicrafts at the Angkor Night Market, catch live music, or just soak in the atmosphere with a $0.50 draft beer.
details: 📍 Pub Street & Angkor Night Market, central Siem Reap
🛍️ Bargain for silk scarves, silver jewelry, and T-shirts
🍺 Pub Street is pedestrian-only after 5 PM

days.neighborhoods: Tonlé Sap Lake · Kompong Khleang · Floating Villages
days.title: Life on the Water
days.description: Escape the temples for a day on Southeast Asia's largest freshwater lake. Visit an authentic floating village and witness a way of life that has endured for centuries.

activities.name: 🚤 Kompong Khleang Floating Village
activities.description: The largest and most authentic floating village on Tonlé Sap — far less touristy than Kompong Phluk. Stilted houses tower above the water during rainy season. Take a boat through the village and onto the open lake.
details: 📍 Kompong Khleang, 55 km east of Siem Reap (1-hour drive)
🚤 Boat tour: $20–30 per boat (seats 2–4)
💡 July = high water season — the village is fully afloat and at its most dramatic
tips: Bring sunscreen, a hat, and water. There's little shade on the lake.

activities.name: 🐊 Prek Toal Bird Sanctuary
activities.description: A UNESCO biosphere reserve home to rare waterbirds including spot-billed pelicans and painted storks. Rainy season brings peak bird activity.
details: 📍 Prek Toal, northwest corner of Tonlé Sap
🐦 Combine with Kompong Khleang or book separately
📸 Bring binoculars and a zoom lens

activities.name: 💆 Traditional Khmer Massage
activities.description: After a day on the water, unwind with a traditional oil massage. Siem Reap has excellent spas at very affordable prices.
details: 📍 Bodia Spa or Lemongrass Garden — both near Old Market
💆 1-hour massage: $12–20 per person
💡 Book in advance during peak season

days.title: Countryside Adventures
days.description: Trade tuk-tuks for bicycles and explore Siem Reap's verdant countryside — ancient pre-Angkorian temples, a traditional silk farm, and rice paddies stretching to the horizon.

activities.name: 🚲 Countryside Cycling Tour
activities.description: Pedal through rural villages, past lotus ponds and rice paddies on quiet red-dirt roads. Stop at a local family's house for palm sugar snacks and learn about rural Cambodian life.
details: 📍 Various operators — Grasshopper Adventures or Siem Reap Cycling recommended
🚲 $30–40 per person including bike, guide, water, and snacks
⏱️ 3–4 hours, mostly flat terrain

activities.name: 🧵 Artisans Angkor Silk Farm
activities.description: Free guided tour showing the entire silk-making process — from mulberry trees and silkworms to weaving on traditional looms. A beautiful social enterprise employing rural artisans.
details: 📍 Artisans Angkor, Puok District (20 min from town)
🎟️ Free admission and guided tours
🛍️ The shop has gorgeous silk products at fair-trade prices

activities.name: 🏛️ Roluos Group — The Oldest Temples
activities.description: Pre-date Angkor Wat by 300 years. Bakong, Preah Ko, and Lolei are peaceful, rarely visited, and offer a fascinating look at early Khmer architecture.
details: 📍 Roluos, 13 km east of Siem Reap
💡 Covered by your Angkor Pass
⏱️ 1.5–2 hours for all three temples
tips: The monastery at Lolei has friendly monks who may invite you for tea and conversation.

activities.name: 🍸 Sunset Cocktails & Fine Dining
activities.description: End the day with rooftop drinks overlooking the city, followed by a special dinner at one of Siem Reap's best restaurants.
details: 🍸 Miss Wong — iconic art deco cocktail bar in an old Chinese shophouse
📍 The Lane, off Pub Street

days.title: Last Light on Ancient Stones
days.description: A final morning to catch temples you missed, visit the sobering War Museum, and pick up last-minute souvenirs before heading home.

activities.name: 🏛️ Preah Khan & Neak Pean
activities.description: Two stunning but less-visited temples. Preah Khan is a sprawling complex with atmospheric corridors; Neak Pean is a small island temple reached via a wooden boardwalk over a flooded forest.
details: 📍 North of Angkor Thom (Grand Circuit)
💡 Preah Khan is huge — focus on the central sanctuary and Hall of Dancers
🌊 Neak Pean's boardwalk is especially beautiful during rainy season with the flooded forest

activities.name: ⚔️ Cambodia War Museum
activities.description: A sobering but essential visit. Outdoor museum with tanks, artillery, and landmine exhibits. Personal stories from veterans who serve as guides bring Cambodia's painful history to life.
details: 📍 National Road 6, Siem Reap
🎟️ $5 per person
⏱️ 1–1.5 hours

activities.name: 🛍️ Old Market & Souvenirs
activities.description: Browse Psar Chas (Old Market) for kramas (traditional scarves), kampot pepper, Angkor cookies, and handmade jewelry. A perfect spot for last-minute gifts.
details: 📍 Psar Chas, central Siem Reap
💡 Bargain gently — start at 50% of asking price
🎁 Kampot pepper and palm sugar make excellent souvenirs
tips: Allow 2 hours before your flight for the short drive to the airport. Siem Reap's new airport (SAI) is 40 km from town.
